The private direct-native runner now pins delivery before every fixed Docker pull, volume creation, container run, copy, stop and removal. A timeout, failed response or local bookkeeping failure before confirmed completion retains that pin. Reads and resource presence never clear it. Cleanup refuses before any release while mutation or exec delivery is unresolved; failed cleanup mutations stop later releases. Only the bounded successful reply clears a non-exec pin. Docker exec keeps its existing successful reply plus actual empty ExecIDs condition.

The new immutable execution contract binds independently source-accepted package compatibility R3, candidate 5777f8e35b22c274d44f0363ede1dd40ceb4f880, its complete Go source inventory and original four literal native tests. The historical d99b contract and all previous helper freezes and correction-required receipts remain preserved. Product source and its real Git index were not changed.

All execution is UNRUN. No helper import, Docker call, image/tool download, package install, service start, compiler or test was performed by the author. C must independently review these frozen bytes; root alone may execute serially after acceptance. The proposed root command is in the freeze, not executed evidence.

The supported acceptance scope remains direct internal native package tests in a positively owned disposable Debian12 ARM64 root. Actual loop/kernel/tool/capability/budget compatibility, cleanup and native outcomes must be observed. Installed systemd/helper IPC, zero-cap daemon/default backend, AMD64, broader lifecycle/fault/restart and result golden/canonical registration remain separate follow-ups. Test-only mount and UID/GID fixture capabilities do not grant the product daemon or helper extra capabilities.
